$comment: What each negative vector mutates and why it must be refused. The explanations live HERE and not inside the documents: a comment property inside an artifact is an unknown property, which made every negative refuse as MALFORMED and left each one's actual reason untested.

vectors.tampered-mandatory-verdict: A mandatory verdict changed by one trailing space. Length prefixing means even whitespace changes the preimage.
vectors.dropped-mandatory-control: A control removed. The count is emitted before the entries, so a shorter list cannot pass as the signed one.
vectors.tampered-egress-verdict: An egress verdict flipped. Egress controls are inside the signature exactly so this is detectable.
vectors.tampered-assessed-at: One second later. Freshness cannot be extended by editing the artifact.
vectors.tampered-profile-version: Evidence taken under the airgapped profile relabelled as the networked one.
vectors.tampered-probe-image-digest: A different probe image. The whole assessment describes what that image did.
vectors.tampered-proxy-image-digest: A different proxy image behind an unchanged EGRESS_PROXY_IMAGE_PINNED=PASS.
vectors.tampered-runtime: A different runtime family claiming the same observations.
vectors.tampered-runtime-subject: Evidence from one runtime relabelled for another. THE host-A-authorizes-host-B case.
vectors.tampered-payload-digest: The digest edited to match nothing. Recomputed, never trusted.
vectors.tampered-signature: One character of the signature. The payload is untouched, so only signature verification can refuse it.
vectors.key-id-does-not-match-signature: Claims key 2; signed by key 1. keyId is inside the preimage, so the digest changes too.
vectors.signed-by-a-different-trusted-key: Claims key 1 and carries key 2's signature over the SAME payload. The digest matches; only resolving exactly one key by id refuses it. A verifier that tried every trusted key would accept this.
vectors.unknown-key-id: A key id nothing is pinned for. A key id is not authority.
vectors.wrong-algorithm: A different algorithm identifier. The verifier accepts exactly ED25519 and does not dispatch.
vectors.missing-signature: No signature at all. Absent evidence is not a pass.
vectors.unknown-property: An undefined top-level property. FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES does not apply to tree parsing, so this needs an explicit allowlist.
vectors.unsigned-v2: The old unsigned document. Refused outright: no fallback path and no migration window.
vectors.tampered-sandbox-runtime: The sandbox runtime edited after signing, so the document names a boundary its evidence was not taken behind. Inside the preimage, so the digest moves.
vectors.self-contradictory-runtime: Genuinely signed, and its two statements about one boundary disagree: securityProfileVersion says kaas.sandbox.v1 while sandboxRuntime says GVISOR. Authentic and still refused - no reading of it is the truth, and resolving the disagreement in favour of either field would let a producer choose which.
vectors.superseded-v3: A v3 document, authentic under the v3 domain separator. Refused for its schema exactly as v2 is: a superseded schema is never downgraded to, and the separator moved with the version so v3 bytes can never verify as v4.
vectors.tampered-runtime-implementation-digest: The measured digest of the sandbox runtime binary, changed. This is the field that says WHICH program will confine the execution, so altering it is the forgery that would let evidence gathered against one build of runsc authorize execution under another.
vectors.tampered-runtime-implementation-version: The runtime's reported version, changed while the digest stays. A document whose two statements about the runtime disagree is not a document to reason from.
vectors.tampered-runtime-implementation-name: The runtime registration name changed from runsc to runc, so the evidence claims to describe a different registration than the one it measured.
vectors.tampered-runtime-implementation-path: The opaque path identity changed. Present so that repointing a symlink at a different build is a change to the evidence even when some copy of the old binary still exists.
vectors.superseded-v4: A genuine v4 document, signed by a trusted key under the v4 domain separator. It names the runtime family, the profile and the subject and says nothing about which binary confines the sandbox. Refused as a superseded schema rather than accepted, because that silence is exactly what v5 exists to end.
